text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up — ran into a correctness edge when prefix entries are evicted while a lease handoff is in progress. repro in staging.

tom: can you paste the minimal repro flow?

maria: sure, tl;dr: lease owner A starts migrating prefix K to shard B, eviction on shard B frees the backing slot mid-handshake, then request from client sees a stale pointer and returns wrong tokens.

li: hmm, do we have a strong invariant for 'lease + residency'? iirc leases were supposed to prevent eviction until commit.

dena: we have a soft-lease today (lease is advisory to eviction). we avoided hard locks for perf but this seems like a correctness hole.

deploy-bot: deployment note: rolling dev cluster tested with the repro build @ 2026-02-14 09:12Z

maria: repro steps (condensed):
```text
1) P1 put into shard-A, lease granted to worker-a
2) worker-a starts prefix transfer to shard-B (handshake step 1)
3) shard-B eviction policy triggers while transfer not yet committed
4) eviction reclaims the slot and new request binds an empty slot -> stale read
```

tom: two axes of fix: make lease prevent eviction (strong lease) or make transfer atomic (txn/commit barrier). both have perf implications.

li: what about a lightweight 'reservation' counter separate from lease TTL? eviction checks reservation==0 before reclaim.

dena: that could work. reservation increments on handshake start and decrements on final ack. cheap and avoids global locks.

maria: concern: what if the worker crashes before decrementing? we'd leak reservation and block future evictions.

tom: we can attach reservation to the lease TTL; reservations auto-expire like leases. if worker dies, reservation clears after TTL.

li: need careful ordering: reservation must be visible to evictor before transfer writes the new pointer, else we still race.

maria: propose protocol change:
- step A: sender acquires short reservation (lease-like, idempotent)
- step B: sender sends transfer intent + new KV to target with reservation id
- step C: target commits pointer atomically only if reservation present
- step D: sender deletes old pointer and releases reservation

dena: ordering looks safe. eviction checks for reservation presence; commit is conditional.

tom: two further tradeoffs: reservation TTL hurts capacity for long stalls; conditional commit needs CAS on pointer which we already have for versioned KVs.

li: can we add a lightweight metrics tag for stuck reservations so SRE can alert on leaked reservations? helps ops.

maria: good idea — add reserved_count and reservation_age per shard to console. also expose lease/reservation id in trace for debugging.

dena: one more thought: for multi-tenant sharing we cannot assume single-process batch. reservation protocol must be lang-agnostic and idempotent (HTTP/gRPC friendly).

maria: agreed — implement reservation as a small RPC: `POST /kv/reserve { prefix, ttl } -> { reservation_id }` and `POST /kv/release { reservation_id }`.

tom: also include `GET /kv/reservation/{id}` for health checks.

li: ok. any objections to this plan? seems less invasive than full transactional transfer.

dena: +1 pending perf bench. we should run microbench with 0.1ms reservation path added.

maria: i'll spin up a bench and a spike PR. will also add the console metrics. ping me if you want to pair on the HTTP shape.

tom: thanks — please tag #eng-runtime and add a short summary to the RFC thread.

maria: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
